dedupe_keys.name: genesys mod transport sensitivities data and model code for hainsch preprint identifying policy areas for the transition of the transportation sector

description: Karlo Hainsch at Technische Universität Berlin publishes GENeSYS-MOD inputs, GAMS model files and outputs for a study of transport-transition policy in Germany. The native description says that the result bundle contains a base case, all sensitivity results and Tableau files used for the figures. Its linked preprint abstract describes 400 sensitivities examining modal shift, avoided demand, electrification and carbon prices across the energy system. The archives form one study dataset; they are not separate resources for each sensitivity. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Germany. A limitation is that the complete scenario period, time aggregation and numerical units are not stated in the dataset description. The linked case-study record reports the paper’s stated findings, while the GENeSYS-MOD entry describes the model family. No archive was opened and reproducibility was not tested.
